title: A code change under an intent that says code is not changed is flagged
text:
diff --git a/app/core.py b/app/core.py
--- a/app/core.py
+++ b/app/core.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def total(items):
-    return sum(item.price for item in items)
+    return sum(item.price * item.qty for item in items)
diff --git a/tests/test_core.py b/tests/test_core.py
--- a/tests/test_core.py
+++ b/tests/test_core.py
@@ -4,3 +4,6 @@
         self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 1)]), 2)
+
+    def test_total_uses_quantity(self):
+        self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 3)]), 6)
intent: READMEの誤字を修正する。コードは変更しない。
rationale: The intent states an explicit scope limit and the diff changes source files outside it. The same diff under an intent without the limit is not flagged.
